shared_arithmetic_backend: FLINT; producer fmpz_mat integer determinant, verifier nmod_mat field determinants. Separate certificate logic and integer bounds; not advertised as independent implementations of every arithmetic operation.
proth_prime_proof: q=k*2^32+1<2^64, k odd, a^((q-1)/2)=-1 mod q implies every prime divisor r of q is 1 mod 2^32 and hence exceeds sqrt(q), so q is prime.
